verdict.rationale: Secureframe is a compliance SaaS with generative AI features (Comply AI for policies, risk, and vendor reviews), so asking whether customer data can be kept out of AI model training is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack has no data-use policy, training opt-out, or AI data-handling commitment. The AI-feature and MCP-server items describe what the AI does, not how customer data is treated for training.
